---- MODULE OpenAddressing ----
EXTENDS OpenAddressingDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL OAProof == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL OASeq == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems

OAEvictPC == {"strIns", "nestedIns", "set", "flush", "rtrn"}
OAPC == OAEvictPC \cup {"pick", "Done", "put", "waitEv", "endWEv",
                        "chkSnc", "cntns", "onSnc", "insrt", "isMth",
                        "cas", "tryEv", "waitIns", "endEv"}
OAFrame(a,b,c) == [procedure |-> "Evict", pc |-> "endEv",
                   ei |-> a, ej |-> b, lo |-> c]
OACompleteSub == \A s \in Writer: pc[s] = "Done" => fps \subseteq history
OACompletionInv ==
    /\ pc \in [Writer -> OAPC]
    /\ fp \in [Writer -> fps \cup {0}]
    /\ stack = [s \in Writer |-> stack[s]]
    /\ \A s \in Writer:
         /\ (pc[s] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp[s] \in fps)
         /\ IF pc[s] \in OAEvictPC
               THEN \E a,b,c: stack[s] = <<OAFrame(a,b,c)>>
               ELSE stack[s] = <<>>
    /\ history \subseteq fps
    /\ OACompleteSub

LEMMA OAStackOps ==
    \A a,b,c:
      /\ <<OAFrame(a,b,c)>> \o <<>> = <<OAFrame(a,b,c)>>
      /\ Head(<<OAFrame(a,b,c)>>).pc = "endEv"
      /\ Tail(<<OAFrame(a,b,c)>>) = <<>>
BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAFrame

LEMMA OACompletionInit == Init => OACompletionInv
BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Init, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
                        ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC

LEMMA OACompletionStep == OACompletionInv /\ [Next]_vars => OACompletionInv'
<1>1. ASSUME OACompletionInv, NEW s \in Writer
      PROVE (pick(s) \/ put(s) \/ waitEv(s) \/ endWEv(s) \/ chkSnc(s)
             \/ cntns(s) \/ onSnc(s) \/ insrt(s) \/ isMth(s)
             \/ cas(s) \/ tryEv(s) \/ waitIns(s) \/ endEv(s)
             \/ strIns(s) \/ nestedIns(s) \/ set(s) \/ flush(s) \/ rtrn(s))
             => OACompletionInv'
<2>1. CASE pick(s)
<3>1. pc' \in [Writer -> OAPC]
 BY <1>1, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF pick, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>2. fp' \in [Writer -> fps \cup {0}]
 BY <1>1, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF pick, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>3. stack' = [t \in Writer |-> stack'[t]]
 BY <1>1, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF pick, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>4. \A t \in Writer:
         /\ (pc'[t] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp'[t] \in fps)
         /\ IF pc'[t] \in OAEvictPC
               THEN \E a,b,c: stack'[t] = <<OAFrame(a,b,c)>>
               ELSE stack'[t] = <<>>
 BY <1>1, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF pick, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>5. history' \subseteq fps
 BY <1>1, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF pick, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>6. OACompleteSub'
 BY OAProof!SetExtensionality, <1>1, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF pick, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>7. QED BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, <3>5, <3>6 DEF OACompletionInv
<2>2. CASE put(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>2, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF put, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>3. CASE waitEv(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>3, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF waitEv, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>4. CASE endWEv(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>4, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF endWEv, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>5. CASE chkSnc(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>5, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF chkSnc, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>6. CASE cntns(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>6, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF cntns, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>7. CASE onSnc(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>7, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF onSnc, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>8. CASE insrt(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>8, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF insrt, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>9. CASE isMth(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>9, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF isMth, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>10. CASE cas(s)
<3>1. pc' \in [Writer -> OAPC]
 BY <1>1, <2>10, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF cas, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>2. fp' \in [Writer -> fps \cup {0}]
 BY <1>1, <2>10, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF cas, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>3. stack' = [t \in Writer |-> stack'[t]]
 BY <1>1, <2>10, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF cas, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>4. \A t \in Writer:
         /\ (pc'[t] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp'[t] \in fps)
         /\ IF pc'[t] \in OAEvictPC
               THEN \E a,b,c: stack'[t] = <<OAFrame(a,b,c)>>
               ELSE stack'[t] = <<>>
 BY <1>1, <2>10, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF cas, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>5. history' \subseteq fps
 BY <1>1, <2>10, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF cas, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>6. OACompleteSub'
 BY OAProof!SetExtensionality, <1>1, <2>10, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF cas, OACompletionInv,
     OACompleteSub, ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC
<3>7. QED BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, <3>5, <3>6 DEF OACompletionInv
<2>11. CASE tryEv(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>11, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF tryEv, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>12. CASE waitIns(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>12, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF waitIns, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>13. CASE endEv(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>13, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF endEv, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>14. CASE strIns(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>14, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF strIns, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>15. CASE nestedIns(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>15, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF nestedIns, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>16. CASE set(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>16, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF set, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>17. CASE flush(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>17, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF flush, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>18. CASE rtrn(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>18, OAStackOps, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF rtrn, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub,
      ProcSet, OAPC, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>19. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7, <2>8, <2>9, <2>10, <2>11, <2>12, <2>13, <2>14, <2>15, <2>16, <2>17, <2>18
<1>2. OACompletionInv /\ UNCHANGED vars => OACompletionInv'
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF vars, OACompletionInv, OACompleteSub
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Next, Evict, p, Terminating, ProcSet

LEMMA OACompletionAlways == Spec => []OACompletionInv
<1>1. Init => OACompletionInv BY OACompletionInit
<1>2. OACompletionInv /\ [Next]_vars => OACompletionInv' BY OACompletionStep
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, OAProof!PTL DEF Spec

\* Types needed for the ordered external sequences.  The table can also
\* contain the distinguished empty value, but every other value is integral.
OANumericData ==
    /\ table \in [1..K -> Int \cup {empty}]
    /\ ei \in [Writer -> Int]
    /\ ej \in [Writer -> Int]
    /\ lo \in [Writer -> Int \cup {empty}]

OAStackNumeric ==
    \A s \in Writer: pc[s] \in OAEvictPC =>
          \E a,b \in Int, c \in Int \cup {empty}:
               stack[s] = <<OAFrame(a,b,c)>>

OANumericInv == OANumericData /\ OAStackNumeric

LEMMA OAModRange == \A i \in Int: mod(i,K) \in 1..K
BY OAAssumption, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF mod

LEMMA OANumericInit == Init => OANumericInv
BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Init, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, ProcSet, OAEvictPC

LEMMA OANumericStep ==
    OACompletionInv /\ OANumericInv /\ [Next]_vars => OANumericInv'
<1>1. ASSUME OACompletionInv, OANumericInv, NEW s \in Writer
      PROVE (p(s) \/ Evict(s)) => OANumericInv'
<2>0. /\ pc \in [Writer -> OAPC]
       /\ fp[s] \in Int
       /\ stack = [t \in Writer |-> stack[t]]
       /\ (pc[s] \notin OAEvictPC => stack[s] = <<>>)
  BY <1>1, OAAssumption, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OACompletionInv
<2>1. CASE pick(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>1, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF pick, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>2. CASE put(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>2, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF put, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>3. CASE waitEv(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>3, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF waitEv, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>4. CASE endWEv(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>4, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF endWEv, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>5. CASE chkSnc(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>5, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF chkSnc, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>6. CASE cntns(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>6, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF cntns, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>7. CASE onSnc(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>7, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF onSnc, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>8. CASE insrt(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>8, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF insrt, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>9. CASE isMth(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>9, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF isMth, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>10. CASE cas(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>10, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF cas, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>11. CASE tryEv(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>11, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF tryEv, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>12. CASE waitIns(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>12, OAStackOps, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF waitIns, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>13. CASE endEv(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>13, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF endEv, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>14. CASE strIns(s)
  <3>1. OANumericData'
    BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>14, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
       DEF strIns, OANumericInv, OANumericData
  <3>2. \A t \in Writer: pc'[t] \in OAEvictPC =>
            (pc[t] \in OAEvictPC /\ stack'[t] = stack[t])
    BY <2>0, <2>14, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF strIns, OAEvictPC
  <3>3. OAStackNumeric'
    BY <1>1, <3>2, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OANumericInv, OAStackNumeric
  <3>4. QED BY <3>1, <3>3 DEF OANumericInv
<2>15. CASE nestedIns(s)
  <3>1. OANumericData'
    BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>15, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
       DEF nestedIns, OANumericInv, OANumericData
  <3>2. \A t \in Writer: pc'[t] \in OAEvictPC =>
            (pc[t] \in OAEvictPC /\ stack'[t] = stack[t])
    BY <2>0, <2>15, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF nestedIns, OAEvictPC
  <3>3. OAStackNumeric'
    BY <1>1, <3>2, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OANumericInv, OAStackNumeric
  <3>4. QED BY <3>1, <3>3 DEF OANumericInv
<2>16. CASE set(s)
  <3>1. OANumericData'
    BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>16, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
       DEF set, OANumericInv, OANumericData
  <3>2. \A t \in Writer: pc'[t] \in OAEvictPC =>
            (pc[t] \in OAEvictPC /\ stack'[t] = stack[t])
    BY <2>0, <2>16, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF set, OAEvictPC
  <3>3. OAStackNumeric'
    BY <1>1, <3>2, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OANumericInv, OAStackNumeric
  <3>4. QED BY <3>1, <3>3 DEF OANumericInv
<2>17. CASE flush(s)
  <3>1. OANumericData'
    BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>17, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
       DEF flush, OANumericInv, OANumericData
  <3>2. \A t \in Writer: pc'[t] \in OAEvictPC =>
            (pc[t] \in OAEvictPC /\ stack'[t] = stack[t])
    BY <2>0, <2>17, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF flush, OAEvictPC
  <3>3. OAStackNumeric'
    BY <1>1, <3>2, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OANumericInv, OAStackNumeric
  <3>4. QED BY <3>1, <3>3 DEF OANumericInv
<2>18. CASE rtrn(s)
  BY <1>1, <2>0, <2>18, OAModRange, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF rtrn, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric, OAEvictPC, OAFrame
<2>19. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7, <2>8, <2>9, <2>10, <2>11, <2>12, <2>13, <2>14, <2>15, <2>16, <2>17, <2>18 DEF p, Evict
<1>2. OANumericInv /\ UNCHANGED vars => OANumericInv'
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF vars, OANumericInv, OANumericData, OAStackNumeric
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
           DEF Next, Terminating, ProcSet

LEMMA OANumericAlways == Spec => []OANumericInv
<1>1. Init => OANumericInv BY OANumericInit
<1>2. OACompletionInv /\ OANumericInv /\ [Next]_vars => OANumericInv'
  BY OANumericStep
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, OACompletionAlways, OAProof!PTL DEF Spec

LEMMA OACompletionImplies == OACompletionInv => CompleteAsSafety
<1>1. OACompletionInv => (history \subseteq fps /\ OACompleteSub)
  BY DEF OACompletionInv
<1>2. (history \subseteq fps /\ OACompleteSub) => CompleteAsSafety
  BY OAProof!SetExtensionality, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
     DEF OACompleteSub, CompleteAsSafety, ProcSet
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2
OAOrdered(s) == s \in Seq(Int) /\ \A i,j \in 1..Len(s): i<j => s[i]<s[j]
LEMMA OASelectRec ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Int), NEW e \in Int, NEW Test(_)
  PROVE SelectSeq(Append(s,e), Test) =
     IF Test(e) THEN Append(SelectSeq(s,Test),e) ELSE SelectSeq(s,Test)
BY OAProof!SMTT("r5")
LEMMA OASelectRange ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Int), NEW Test(_)
  PROVE \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)):
         \E j \in 1..Len(s): SelectSeq(s,Test)[i] = s[j]
<1>1. s \in Seq({s[i]: i \in 1..Len(s)})
  BY OASeq!SeqOfRange, OASeq!RangeEquality
<1>2. SelectSeq(s,Test) \in Seq({s[i]: i \in 1..Len(s)})
  BY <1>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. QED BY <1>2, OASeq!ElementOfSeq, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
LEMMA OASelectInfo ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Int), NEW Test(_)
  PROVE /\ SelectSeq(s, Test) \in Seq(Int)
        /\ \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s, Test)): Test(SelectSeq(s, Test)[i])
BY OAProof!SMTT("r5")

LEMMA OAOrderedAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Int), NEW e \in Int
  PROVE OAOrdered(Append(s,e)) <=> (OAOrdered(s) /\ \A i \in 1..Len(s): s[i] < e)
BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrdered

LEMMA OASelectOrdered ==
  ASSUME NEW s, OAOrdered(s), NEW Test(_)
  PROVE OAOrdered(SelectSeq(s, Test))
<1>1. DEFINE PP(t) == OAOrdered(t) => OAOrdered(SelectSeq(t,Test))
<1>2. PP(<<>>)
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF PP, OAOrdered
<1>3. ASSUME NEW t \in Seq(Int), NEW e \in Int, PP(t), OAOrdered(Append(t,e))
      PROVE OAOrdered(SelectSeq(Append(t,e),Test))
  <2>1. OAOrdered(t) /\ \A i \in 1..Len(t): t[i] < e
    BY <1>3, OAOrderedAppend
  <2>2. OAOrdered(SelectSeq(t,Test))
    BY <1>3, <2>1 DEF PP
  <2>3. \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(t,Test)):
          \E j \in 1..Len(t): SelectSeq(t,Test)[i] = t[j]
    BY OASelectRange
  <2>4. \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(t,Test)): SelectSeq(t,Test)[i] < e
    BY <2>1, <2>3, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
  <2>5. OAOrdered(Append(SelectSeq(t,Test),e))
    BY <2>2, <2>4, OAOrderedAppend DEF OAOrdered
  <2>6. SelectSeq(Append(t,e), Test) =
          IF Test(e) THEN Append(SelectSeq(t,Test),e) ELSE SelectSeq(t,Test)
    BY OASelectRec
  <2>7. QED BY <2>2, <2>5, <2>6
<1>4. \A t \in Seq(Int): PP(t)
  BY <1>2, <1>3, OASeq!SequencesInductionAppend DEF PP
<1>5. QED BY <1>4 DEF PP, OAOrdered

LEMMA OAOrderedConcat ==
  ASSUME NEW s, NEW t, OAOrdered(s), OAOrdered(t),
         \A i \in 1..Len(s): \A j \in 1..Len(t): s[i]<t[j]
  PROVE OAOrdered(s \o t)
<1>1. s \o t \in Seq(Int)
  BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrdered
<1>2. ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(s \o t), NEW j \in 1..Len(s \o t), i < j
      PROVE (s \o t)[i] < (s \o t)[j]
  <2>1. CASE j <= Len(s)
    BY <1>2, <2>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrdered
  <2>2. CASE i > Len(s)
    BY <1>2, <2>2, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrdered
  <2>3. CASE i <= Len(s) /\ j > Len(s)
    BY <1>2, <2>3, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrdered
  <2>4. QED BY <1>2, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrdered
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF OAOrdered

LEMMA OAOrderedLast ==
  ASSUME NEW s, OAOrdered(s), s # <<>>
  PROVE /\ largestElem(s) \in Int
        /\ \A i \in 1..Len(s): s[i] <= largestElem(s)
BY OASeq!EmptySeq, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrdered, largestElem, last

LEMMA OAOrderedImplies ==
  ASSUME NEW s, OAOrdered(s)
  PROVE isSorted(s)
<1>1. OAOrdered(SelectSeq(s,LAMBDA e: e # empty))
  BY OASelectOrdered
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrdered, isSorted

LEMMA OAOrderedAbove ==
  ASSUME NEW s, NEW t, OAOrdered(s), OAOrdered(t),
         \A j \in 1..Len(t): t[j] > largestElem(s)
  PROVE OAOrdered(s \o t)
<1>1. s # <<>> => (largestElem(s) \in Int /\ \A i \in 1..Len(s): s[i] <= largestElem(s))
  BY OAOrderedLast
<1>2. \A i \in 1..Len(s): \A j \in 1..Len(t): s[i] < t[j]
  BY <1>1, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrdered
<1>3. QED BY <1>2, OAOrderedConcat

LEMMA OAOrderedMerge ==
  ASSUME NEW s, NEW t, OAOrdered(s), OAOrdered(t), NEW e \in Int, e > largestElem(t)
  PROVE OAOrdered(Append(t \o subSeqSmaller(s,t,e),e))
<1>1. OAOrdered(subSeqSmaller(s,t,e))
  BY OASelectOrdered DEF subSeqSmaller
<1>2. \A i \in 1..Len(subSeqSmaller(s,t,e)):
         subSeqSmaller(s,t,e)[i] < e /\ subSeqSmaller(s,t,e)[i] > largestElem(t)
  BY OASelectInfo DEF subSeqSmaller, OAOrdered

  BY <1>1, <1>2, OAOrderedAbove

  BY OAOrderedLast

  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OAOrdered

  <2>2. \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s,LAMBDA OAelt: OAelt > largestElem(t))):
          SelectSeq(s,LAMBDA OAelt: OAelt > largestElem(t))[i] > largestElem(t)
    BY OASelectInfo DEF OAOrdered
  <2>3. QED BY <1>2, <2>1, <2>2, OAOrderedAbove DEF subSeqLarger
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

  BY OAProof!SMTT("r5") DEF OASortedInv

  <2>1. (ei[s] <= K+L /\ lo'[s] # empty) => lo'[s] \in Int

  <2>5. QED BY <1>2, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, OAProof!SMTT("r5")
